# Modern Snake Game (Pythonic)

> Modern Snake (Pythonic) is a high-performance, mobile-friendly 60FPS browser arcade game engineered in pure Vanilla JavaScript with zero external frameworks or dependencies. It features 8 dynamic power-up items, single-player intelligent A* pathfinding AI rival bots, procedural Web Audio synthesizer sound effects, instant offline Progressive Web App (PWA) installation, and competitive global leaderboards.

## Core Pages & Play Links
- [Play Modern Snake Game](https://pythonics.vercel.app/): Instant 60FPS browser arcade game with no downloads or registration.
- [How to Play & Strategy Guide](https://pythonics.vercel.app/instructions): Complete gameplay instructions, movement controls, scoring formulas, power-up items, and leaderboard tactics.
- [Developer & Strategy Blog](https://pythonics.vercel.app/blog): Engineering deep dives, arcade history, algorithms, game rankings, and performance optimization guides.
- [XML Sitemap](https://pythonics.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all pages and articles.
- [Full Text Digest](https://pythonics.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive documentation and technical extracts for LLM knowledge ingestion.

## Game Mechanics & Power-Up System
- **Movement Controls**: Desktop Arrow Keys / WASD, mobile touch swipe gestures, and virtual on-screen D-pad.
- **Dynamic Speed Scaling**: Game ticks accelerate as your snake grows, testing reflexes at higher levels.
- **Combo Multiplier**: Collecting food pellets in rapid succession triggers score multipliers up to 4x.
- **8 Distinct Power-Up Items**:
  1. *Speed Boost (Golden Bolt)*: Increases velocity for high-speed aggressive food collection.
  2. *Slow Motion / Freeze (Cyan Snowflake)*: Halves tick speed, providing critical escape reaction time in congested areas.
  3. *Ghost Mode (Purple Phantom)*: Grants 5 seconds of collision immunity through the snake's own tail.
  4. *Score Double (Yellow Star)*: Multiplies incoming points by 2x for a limited duration.
  5. *Magnet (Blue Horseshoe)*: Pulls nearby food items directly to the snake's head coordinate.
  6. *Food Frenzy (Red Apple Cluster)*: Spawns a cluster of bonus food pellets across the board.
  7. *Shrink Pellets (Green Pill)*: Trims 25% of current body length, freeing up congested grid space.
  8. *Shield (Bronze Aegis)*: Absorbs a single fatal wall or obstacle impact.
- **Intelligent A* AI Rivals**: Bot snakes execute real-time Manhattan distance heuristic pathfinding with forward reachability flood-fill safety checks to contest food without self-trapping.

## Technical Architecture
- **Language & Runtime**: 100% Vanilla JavaScript ES Modules, HTML5 2D Canvas API.
- **Zero External Dependencies**: No React, Vue, Phaser, Pixi, or npm runtime dependencies (<150KB total bundle).
- **Locked 60FPS Engine**: Driven by `window.requestAnimationFrame()` with fixed-timestep delta accumulation and zero-allocation object pooling to eliminate garbage collection pauses.
- **Procedural Sound Synthesis**: Built with Web Audio API (`AudioContext`, `OscillatorNode`, `GainNode`) for real-time procedural retro chiptune SFX without external audio files.
- **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Offline-first architecture with `sw.js` caching, enabling 100% offline play in airplane mode.
